chapter: Jeter-Pillars in Cleveland and St. Louis
title: Creole Club in Cleveland and meeting Catherine, later Basie's wife
summary: With Jeter-Pillars at the Creole Club he met dancer Catherine and her mother Mrs. Morgan.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah, that's where I met Basie's present wife, Catherine. She was a dancer in the club.

This was around 1935. 1935, yes. And naturally, we all were youngsters at that time. We became very good friends. And I used to go around to her mother's house and she would feed me quite a bit. Mrs. Morgan.
Oh, was she from Cleveland? I didn't know that.
